test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two chords AB and CD of a circle meet inside the circle at point P. If AP = 12 cm, AB = 20 cm and CP = 16 cm, then CD = ?
solution:
**Calculation: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c67eb3760d76ed82f903b96a2378ee1bb43c2c3137edd2db7bdb612622e6b1c.png] 

As per the question,

PB = AB - AP

⇒ 20 - 12 = 8cm

As we know

PA × PB = PD × PC

⇒ 12 × 8 = PD × 16

⇒ PD = 6

Then CD = PD + PC 

⇒ 16 + 6 = 22 cm

**∴ The correct option is 1**
